about.title: Welcome to Winners Chapel International Milwaukee, Wisconsin
about.description: Welcome to the Home of Signs & Wonders! At Winners Chapel International Milwaukee, Wisconsin, we are committed to providing a place of spiritual growth, empowerment, and community. We believe in a life of abundance, guided by the Word of God. Whether you are visiting for the first time or looking for a place to call home, we are here to support you on your faith journey.

weekOfEmphasis: 1st Wednesday, Thursday & Friday of each month – 6:00pm

pastor.label: Resident Pastor
pastor.name: Pastor Ajibola Alaka
pastor.description: Pastor Ajibola Alaka is the current serving Resident Pastor, WCI Milwaukee Wisconsin, United States of America. He is committed to passionately carrying out, and pursuing his God-given assignment and the delivery of the Liberation Mandate.

churchUpdates.label: Church Updates
churchUpdates.title: Stay informed with our special services and programs
churchUpdates.description: We provide weekly updates about all our recent special services, events and programs to ensure that you are current with the latest faith news.

tabs.label: Covenant Hour of Prayer
tabs.title: Covenant Hour of Prayer
tabs.description: We gather every Monday to Saturday at 6:00 AM for the Covenant Hour of Prayer. This is a time for personal and corporate prayer, where we connect with God for spiritual empowerment, direction, and breakthroughs. We encourage all members to start their day in prayer and receive strength for the day ahead.

tabs.label: Winners Satellite Fellowship (WSF)
tabs.title: Winners Satellite Fellowship (WSF)
tabs.description: We gather in homes across the city for our Winners Satellite Fellowship (WSF). This is a time for intimate fellowship, Bible study, and prayer. It's an opportunity to connect with other believers and grow together in faith.
details: Location: Various Locations (Check our WSF Page)

tabs.label: Operation Andrew
tabs.title: Operation Andrew
tabs.description: We believe in the power of personal evangelism, which is why Operation Andrew is held every third Saturday of every month. It is a time when members invite their friends, family, and neighbors to experience the power of the Gospel in an inviting atmosphere.
details: Next Date: Third Saturday of Every Month

tabs.label: Believers Foundation Class (BFS)
tabs.title: Believer's Foundation Class
tabs.description: At Winners Chapel Milwaukee, we are committed to nurturing and growing new believers in Christ. Our Believer's Foundation Class is designed to equip individuals with the foundational knowledge they need to live a victorious Christian life.

tabs.label: Word Of Faith Bible Institute
tabs.title: Word of Faith Bible Institute (WOFBI)
tabs.description: This is a life-changing training centre where we equip believers with the knowledge of God's Word. Through WOFBI, we train future leaders, ministers, and believers who desire to deepen their knowledge of Scripture and live out the Word of God in their daily lives.
